source_and_output_checks: All78TX source CRC checkpoints and driver-output checks passed;56fast clock receipts. Stage CRCs do not exclude transient changes/collisions; API acceptance is not host attestation by itself.

footprint_comparison.scope: Configured snapshots from different image/init/temperature histories, not isolated causal driver cost.

interpretation_limits: Requested baud through240M is not attained RF throughput.
Power AC peaks are finite nominal-clock periodicity observations, not payload BER or qualified RF edge jitter.
Conditional BER counts only selected source-matched payload; missing headers and unsampled periods have no BER value.
Finite snapshots, deferred USB and host batch demodulation do not establish continuous audio, synchronized one-way latency, live ADC/DAC or ultimate PHY limits.
Driver temperatures are outside-window indications; TX10..80C requested range is exceeded by some readings, independent accuracy unknown.

decoder.native_adapter: Signed arithmetic right shift2 from retained I10,-Q10 to frozen I8 interface; no Q flip, mean removal or resampling.
decoder.quality_scope: First known sequence per snapshot, summed over separate repetitions; no whole-run delivery denominator or loss concealment.

highest_framed_timing_observation.scope: Approximately attained software rate; one finite window retains50unsent tail words. Source-word order and boundaryCRC pass do not imply perfect instantaneous clock or RF delivery.
